sources.title: Darshan documentation
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: Slurm Backfill：保留工作起點與空檔利用
related.titleEn: Slurm backfill: protected starts and idle-window use
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：報告用候選／支持／反駁狀態，不以一個平均值宣告根因。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Use candidate/supported/rejected states rather than declaring cause from one average.
related.difference: 以合成資料重建「Slurm Backfill：保留工作起點與空檔利用」，能分離架構事實、模型假設與驗收證據。完成：交付四泳道時間圖、node-minute 帳本與超時反例。
related.differenceEn: Reconstruct Slurm backfill: protected starts and idle-window use with synthetic data; distinguish architecture facts, model assumptions and acceptance evidence. Complete: Deliver four-lane timelines, node-minute ledgers and an overrun counterexample.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 用 64 MiB 和 16384 次計算，再以 4 KiB×16384 反向核對。
計算四節點各使用 30 min，再除整個可用矩形面積。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Calculate from 64 MiB and 16384 calls, then reverse-check with 4 KiB×16384.
Calculate four nodes used for 30 min each and divide by the full available rectangle.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: EasyBuild 驗證矩陣：建置配方、校驗與測試容量
related.titleEn: EasyBuild validation matrices: recipes, checksums and test capacity
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：報告用候選／支持／反駁狀態，不以一個平均值宣告根因。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Use candidate/supported/rejected states rather than declaring cause from one average.
related.difference: 以合成資料重建「EasyBuild 驗證矩陣：建置配方、校驗與測試容量」，能分離架構事實、模型假設與驗收證據。完成：交付easyconfig欄位表、來源checksum、16格測試矩陣與批次排程。
related.differenceEn: Reconstruct EasyBuild validation matrices: recipes, checksums and test capacity with synthetic data; distinguish architecture facts, model assumptions and acceptance evidence. Complete: Deliver easyconfig fields, source checksums, the sixteen-cell test matrix and batch schedule.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 用 64 MiB 和 16384 次計算，再以 4 KiB×16384 反向核對。
展開2×3×2組合，放入三worker、每格4 min的紙面排程。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Calculate from 64 MiB and 16384 calls, then reverse-check with 4 KiB×16384.
Expand 2×3×2 combinations into a three-worker schedule with four minutes per cell.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
